title: Surreal AI Music Video - "A Very Unusual Town" - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
A very unusual town. I love when a video comes together with the music so well. These clips feel like a fairytale. Images made with #Midjourney and animated with ​⁠@Hailuoai_MiniMax  #Minimax. Song made using ​⁠@suno  

#ai #aiart #aivideo #aimusic #suno #aiimages #hailuo #surreal
